code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid) - 1
    marker_row = next(r for r in range(1, len(grid)) if grid[r][0] == 2)
    marker_col = grid[0].index(2)
    start_row = (len(grid) - marker_row) % n
    shift = marker_col - 1
    inner = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(1, len(grid))] for r in range(1, len(grid))]
    inner = [row[-shift:] + row[:-shift] for row in inner]
    return [inner[(start_row + k) % n] for k in range(n)]
'''
